item.title: Indian Navy to conduct joint services multi-speciality camp
item.description: Visakhapatnam: The Indian Navy is organising a ‘joint services multi-speciality medical camp’ in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep from January 12 to 16. item.title: Mika Singh pledges 10 acres to support stray dog welfare, makes heartfelt appeal to Supreme Court
item.description: The singer’s announcement comes against the backdrop of a Supreme Court directive issued in November 2025, which instructed all states and union territories to immediately relocate stray dogs from public places such as schools, hospitals and transport hubs to designated shelters.

item.title: JEE Main 2026: How to Check Exam Centre Details Online
item.description: New Delhi: The National Testing Agency (NTA) will release the JEE Main 2026 exam centre details through the city intimation slip and the admit card on its official website. Candidates appearing for the examination can check their allotted exam city and centre by logging in at https://jeemain.nta.nic.in. item.title: Trump Claims Role Of ‘Acting President Of Venezuela’ After Maduro’s Arrest
item.description: Former US president Donald Trump sparked controversy by posting a digitally altered image calling himself the “Acting President of Venezuela,” days after the capture of Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro.

item.title: India denies plan to demand smartphone source code, says talks still underway
item.description: The Indian government has dismissed reports of mandatory source code sharing, saying smartphone security discussions remain consultative and not legally binding.

item.title: Range-bound trade likely as geopolitical cues loom
item.description: Theweek gone by was one which markets would like to forget in a hurry. We lost on all five days of the week and are back where we began the rally, all over again. When the week closed on Friday, it looked like next week would be yet another new high and now it appears as how much lower can it go. Very clearly, markets teaches us all a lot of things, including hope and pessimism, expectations and assumptions. What we have to learn on our own is tempering all of this and taking it in our stride. B
